verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a bulk-operation capability, such as bulk editing, deleting or updating many flags, experiments, persons or cohorts in one action. What it does show is per-item management through MCP, the CLI and the API, which are building blocks a user could script bulk changes with. The batch export to a warehouse is a data-export feature, not a bulk operation on items, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
